message.content:
This image is a **marketing landing page** for a live streaming app called **"Trigger"**, designed with a clean, modern aesthetic using a white background with green, red, and blue accent colors.

## **HEADER SECTION**

**Top Left:**
- Small uppercase text: "LIVE STREAMING" in green

**Main Headline:**
- Large bold text: "**Stream Your Way**" (dark navy/black)
- Subheadline: "**Free, Paid or Scheduled.**" (bright green)

**Subheading Text:**
- Gray body text: "Go live instantly, monetize your content, or plan ahead. Trigger gives you the flexibility to connect with your audience the way you want."

**Top Right Decorative Elements:**
- Handwritten-style script text: "**Create Connect Grow**" in green
- Light mint green circular/oval background shape
- Script text: "**Same App Different Stories**" in dark green

---

## **THREE-COLUMN FEATURE SECTION**

The page displays three streaming options side-by-side:

### **Column 1: FREE (Green Theme)**
- **Badge:** Rounded rectangle with "FREE" in green text on light green background
- **Title:** "**Free Live Stream**" (bold black)
- **Description:** "Go live instantly and connect with anyone, anytime. Share your moments, interact with your audience and grow your community."
- **Phone Mockup:** Shows a live stream interface with:
  - Red "LIVE" badge and viewer count "1.2K"
  - Female streamer's face
  - Chat comments from users: Arjun, Neha, Rohan, Priya
  - Heart icons and gift icons
- **Feature List** (green checkmarks):
  - No payment required
  - Unlimited live streaming
  - Real-time chat with viewers
  - Gifts and support
  - Perfect for casual and community streams
- **CTA Button:** Green button with "**Start Free Stream →**"

### **Column 2: PAID (Red/Pink Theme)**
- **Badge:** Crown icon + "PAID" in red/pink on light pink background
- **Title:** "**Paid Live Stream**"
- **Description:** "Monetize your content with exclusive live streams. Set your own price and give your audience a premium experience."
- **Phone Mockup:** Shows paid stream interface with:
  - Lock icon + "PAID" badge + viewer count "892"
  - Female streamer in red top
  - Price card: "Unlock this live stream ₹100"
  - White button: "Pay & Join"
  - Footer: "Secure payment powered by Razorpay"
- **Feature List** (red checkmarks):
  - Set your own price
  - Earn from your content
  - Exclusive access for viewers
  - Real-time chat and reactions
  - Build a loyal audience
  - Transparent earnings
- **CTA Button:** Red/coral button with "**Create Paid Stream →**"

### **Column 3: SCHEDULE (Blue Theme)**
- **Badge:** Calendar icon + "SCHEDULE" in blue on light blue background
- **Title:** "**Schedule Live Stream**"
- **Description:** "Plan your live streams in advance and let your audience know. Build excitement, get notifications and reach more viewers."
- **Phone Mockup:** Shows scheduling form with:
  - Header: "Schedule Live" with back arrow
  - Cover image placeholder with "Change Cover"
  - Form fields: Title ("Let's Talk ❤️"), Description, Stream Type (Free/Paid toggle - Paid selected in green), Price (100), Date (5 Sep 2026), Time (08:00 PM)
  - Green "**Schedule Stream**" button at bottom
- **Feature List** (blue checkmarks):
  - Schedule date & time
  - Notify your followers
  - Perfect for events, Q&A, special sessions
  - Supports free or paid streams
  - Auto reminders for viewers
- **CTA Button:** Blue button with "**Schedule Stream →**"

---

## **BOTTOM SECTION: FOR CREATORS**

**Section Header:**
- Label: "FOR CREATORS" (small green uppercase)
- Headline: "**More Control. More Possibilities.**" (large bold black)
- Subtext: "Whether it's a spontaneous chat, an exclusive paid session, or a well-planned event — Trigger gives creators the tools to engage, grow and earn."

**Three Icon Cards (Right Side):**

1. **Green Card** (Chart icon):
   - "**Engage Your Audience**"
   - "Chat, interact and build a loyal community."

2. **Green Card** (Rupee/Currency icon):
   - "**Earn From Your Content**"
   - "Monetize with paid live streams and gifts."

3. **Green Card** (Calendar icon):
   - "**Plan For Bigger Moments**"
   - "Schedule streams and reach more viewers."

**CTA Button:**
- Green button with video camera icon: "**Start Streaming Today →**"

**Decorative Element:**
- Handwritten text: "**Stream Your Story**" in green (right side)

---

## **FOOTER QUOTE**

Centered at bottom with horizontal lines on either side:
> *"Real people. Real conversations. Real connections."*

---

## **DESIGN SUMMARY**

**Color Palette:**
- Primary: Bright green (#22C55E or similar)
- Secondary: Coral red (#EF4444), Blue (#3B82F6)
- Background: White (#FFFFFF) and light mint (#F0FDF4)
- Text: Dark navy/black (#0F172A), gray (#64748B)

**Typography:**
- Sans-serif font family (likely Inter or similar)
- Bold weights for headlines
- Clean, readable body text

**Layout:**
- Responsive grid system
- Generous whitespace
- Card-based design with subtle shadows/borders
- Mobile phone mockups showing actual UI screens

**Visual Style:**
- Modern SaaS aesthetic
- Friendly and approachable tone
- Professional yet casual vibe targeting content creators
